_readme: Clothing. Outfits have their colors written into the prompt (no color picking). In undergarment prompts {color} is replaced with her favorite color (or the outfit's favColor override; colors are listed at the bottom with their swatch hex).

base: generic starting outfits (also sold in the shop). shop: shop-only outfits. Each: label, style (Elegant, Cute, Exotic, Sporty, Revealing), cost, lewd (lewdness she needs to wear it), prompt, bonus.

Outfits can also specify accessories (worn with the outfit, staying on according to her accessory state or the outfit's accState: dressed|under|always), hairStyle (overrides her hairStyle while worn), and features (added to her features while worn). Special (sp_*) outfits on named characters can also override hairColor, eyes, skin, favColor, build, body, expression, pubic, or raceLook.
bonus multiplies income: jobs (maid, promoter, attendant, bartender, dancer, bath, courtesan, madame, security), client classes (commoner, adventurer, merchant, noble) or propose (propositions).
under: undergarments, same fields. Keep the ids plain and none; none (commando) is special-cased.
Named ladies' signature and special outfits live with them in characters/*.json and guests/*.json.
uniform: an outfit tagged with a job (b_maid) is never rolled for generic ladies; she wears it automatically while she holds that job, unless she has a job outfit set (w.jobOutfit[job]).
bath: true marks an outfit that can be worn in bath scenes (e.g. yukata, swimsuit, bathrobe, bikini).

stats: optional {stat:n} on an outfit or undergarment (0-100 scale; beauty, charm, charisma, refinement, wits, stamina, strength, agility). A bonus on top of her trained stats that may exceed the cap. bonus keys also include host, teacher and chapel.
